metadata.description: Personal marketplace for Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive local code review with static analysis, security scanning, dependency auditing, container scanning (Trivy), SonarQube, and best practices enforcement. All analysis is local — never pushes to remote. v5: SSoT JSON outputs with _about metadata, on-demand ticket generation, confidence field, verification steps, and Python version mismatch detection.

plugins.name: update-jira
plugins.description: Post progress updates to Jira tickets based on session work, git activity, and PRs. Supports targeted single-ticket updates and batch scan mode across repos.

plugins.name: confluence-rfc
plugins.description: Create RFC pages in Confluence following the team's established template. Supports PP and APIM spaces, Jira ticket integration, and auto-fills content from conversation context.

plugins.name: git-flow
plugins.description: Safe git workflow enforcer for worktree-based development. Prevents committing to master, pushing to merged branches, and skipping the branching workflow. Handles commit, push, PR creation (Codeberg/Forgejo), and worktree management.

plugins.name: tf-naming-check
plugins.description: Terraform naming convention checker. Reads a team-editable rulebook config and uses a Haiku agent to scan .tf files for naming violations, reporting findings by severity.

plugins.name: repo-wiki
plugins.description: Incremental, merge-safe repository documentation system. Generates wiki pages under .local-review/wiki/ using hash-based change detection, preserving manual notes and avoiding full overwrites.

plugins.name: update-ledger
plugins.description: Multi-workspace chronological work ledger. Pulls Jira tickets and GitHub PRs per workspace (company, solo, client), writes immutable event entries, regenerates per-entity rollups, and produces daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly summaries plus cross-workspace timelines. Survives job changes — workspaces are pluggable. Supports manual notes for work not in Jira/PRs. Delegates per-item composition to cheap haiku subagents to keep main-thread context small.
